charger.topology: NVDC automatic VBUS/BAT selection with BAT supplement
charger.system_priority: reduce charge to zero before reducing an admitted system load

policy.usb_only_source_loss: monotonic safe reset/shutdown; no hold-up duration is claimed
policy.brownout: AON supervisor clears RUN permit; source recovery alone cannot re-arm

datasheet_facts.behavior: DPM limits input current or voltage; VSYSMIN reduces charging first; below that, BATFET supplement supports SYS

residual_physical_only: measure SYS, AON and downstream-rail minima during every USB attach/detach and DPM transition
measure actual BATFET handover and supplement waveforms at low, nominal and full pack voltage
inject weak and current-limited USB sources with healthy, absent and isolated packs
repeat the worst transitions at the declared temperature corners
